thread:
alex (Marketing): quick sync — PartnerCloud reached out, want a co-demo + marketplace listing push. timeline ~4w. need webinar, blog post, launch post, and a short benchmark mention. who can own routing and registration copy?

maya (Partner): love it. we can co-host. propose Apr 21 11am PT (30 demo + 15 Q&A). we can supply a benchmark slide + partner logo pack. legal needs 3 business days for logo usage ok.

sam (Growth): routing note — leads should go into SFDC queue 'Partner Integrations' with lead source = partnercloud_marketplace. can we add utm params: utm_source=partnercloud, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=partner-demo-apr21? Also want a webhook to send registrant -> Segment -> Pardot.

natalie (Content): rough content plan: 1) registration landing copy (50–75 words), 2) blog post (800–1000 words) that doubles as marketplace listing, 3) short announce post for social + email blurb. i'll draft landing + blog skeleton by EOD Wed if owners aligned. need screenshots and benchmark artifact from PartnerCloud.

alex (Marketing): owners: natalie -> content, sam -> lead routing & registration form, maya -> partner assets + legal sign-off. i'll own promo cadence and webinar host.

maya (Partner): confirmed on assets. we'll drop a .zip of logos, a slide in PNG + raw benchmark CSV by Tue. Legal flagged one minor trademark line but should be fine.

sam (Growth): registration form fields: name, email, company, role, use-case checkbox, opt-in. can we add hidden field for "partner_ref" for SFDC mapping? also add `?ref=partnercloud` to link.

natalie (Content): notes — for marketplace listing we need 3 short bullets focused on latency/cost wins. can the engineering PM share a 2-sentence latency stat we can quote?

alex (Marketing): ping @eng-platform for a quick stat. if not available we'll use high-level "30–50% lower token cost" phrasing. need to avoid claiming specifics without eng sign-off.

calendar-bot: Event created: "PartnerCloud x Redwood — Co-demo" Apr 21 11:00 PT. invitees: alex, maya, natalie, sam.

alex (Marketing): decisions: webinar + recording gate (yes), make recording gated behind lead form, repurpose recording into 1 blog + short social clips. timeline: draft landing by Wed, promo starts Mon Apr 6, send final promo calendar Fri Apr 10.

maya (Partner): we'll provide speaker bios and headshots by Thu. also can offer a customer case for the demo if available.

sam (Growth): I'll set up SFDC queue + webhook. need endpoint from eng to push leads; @eng-platform can you confirm auth method?

natalie (Content): I'll put a Notion page and add assignees. quick ask — can someone capture a 45s demo clip for social?

alex (Marketing): yes — @eng-platform or @prod-design can record. otherwise schedule a quick screen capture session with partner.

maya (Partner): thumbs up. one more thing — for marketplace listing, PartnerCloud prefers joint customer quote in listing. can we secure permission from that customer?

alex (Marketing): note made. i'll follow up with success team.

sam (Growth): next actions captured: 1) natalie drafts landing + blog skeleton (due Wed EOD), 2) sam sets up SFDC + webhook (due Mon), 3) maya provides assets (due Tue), 4) alex finalizes promo calendar (due Fri).

natalie (Content): adding content checklist in Notion, will @-mention when draft ready.

alex (Marketing): thanks all. if no objections i'll lock timeline and start promo tasks tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maya (Partner): no objections. excited to launch together! :party_popper:

sam (Growth): all good from routing side.
